the Tasks tab on its filter,
1 · click a row, a chip or a link
each view stacks; Back pops it
a double click on Load more fetched the same
page twice: rows twice, duplicate keys;
fixed in 2a45be98: one page in flight,
the native disabled moves keyboard focus
to the body: the next Tab starts again
at the top of the sheet; the guard
a chip on the Tasks view already shown
left the URL unchanged and focus pending;
First to fail looked in the first 50
failed tasks only; fixed: it follows
page.next; past 250 the line is left out
failed tasks searched, 1 px each, pages of 50

a planted pipeline under a name it chooses;

allocation on a shared login node
python_image takes any string: a mutable
tag can replace the digest pin
